pages.text: $(bold)Falling Blossom$(): petals fall with the wind; the body moves like a dance. $(br2)$(bold)Trigger$(): passively activates while wrapped inside another's Domain (the Cursed Core must have this skill installed). $(br2)$(bold)Effect$(): the caster can still act freely — techniques and items both work, though movement is rather slow; this is how Domain effects are held off (the slashes of Malevolent Shrine and the like are nullified).

$(bold)Limitation$(): $(red)it cannot defend against Unlimited Void's paralysis$() — beneath the Void you will still be frozen in place. $(br2)$(bold)Upkeep$(): drains Cursed Energy continuously at 24 per second; when it runs dry the skill fails; leaving the Domain's range dispels it automatically. $(br2)$(bold)Use$(): a mobile defense for when you must keep fighting / pulling back while still dealing damage.
